name: Berlin
tagline: Culturally Rich EU Capital, Stability Over Arbitrage
description: Berlin is a culturally rich EU capital — more affordable than Munich, Paris, or London — with excellent healthcare, world-class transit, and a large international community. It suits FIRE retirees who prioritize European quality of life and stability over deep cost arbitrage, trading lower headline savings for security, infrastructure, and culture.

quickFacts.visa: No dedicated retirement visa; non-EU retirees use a discretionary general residence permit (§7 AufenthG) with no fixed income threshold — applicants must prove self-sufficiency and hold mandatory health insurance; path to permanent residence after ~5 years
quickFacts.safetyRating: Very safe for a capital; low violent crime, with petty theft at transit hubs
quickFacts.climate: Temperate continental — cold winters and mild summers

housing.description: Small 1BR in the outer ring (Wedding or Neukölln)

dining.description: Mostly home cooking with cheap, diverse eats out

healthcare.description: Public GKV (voluntary) or a basic private plan

entertainment.description: Museums, parks, clubs, and Berlin's free and cheap culture

1M.lifestyle: A small flat in an outer district, home cooking, the unlimited Deutschlandticket, and public insurance. Winter heating bills bite, but Berlin's deep free-and-cheap cultural life keeps a lean budget rich.

housing.description: 1BR in trendy Prenzlauer Berg or Kreuzberg

2M.lifestyle: A flat in a trendy central district, dining out regularly, comprehensive coverage, and easy access to museums, concerts, and Berlin's legendary nightlife. Comfortable city living in a major capital.

3M.lifestyle: A spacious central apartment, frequent quality dining, private health insurance, and frequent European travel from one of the continent's best-connected capitals. The comfortable FIRE tier for Berlin.

housing.description: Luxury apartment in Mitte or Charlottenburg

entertainment.description: Opera, the arts, and frequent travel

luxuryExtras.description: Frequent European travel and premium experiences

5M.lifestyle: A premium central apartment, near-daily dining, top private medicine, and weekly help, with opera, the arts, and frequent travel. Upscale capital living without Munich or Paris prices.

dining.description: Private-chef dining and the finest restaurants

luxuryExtras.description: Bespoke travel, art, and cultural patronage

10M.lifestyle: A Grunewald villa or Mitte penthouse, full household staff, fine dining, premium private healthcare, and an elite cultural and social life. Fat-FIRE in a stable, world-class European capital.
